findings.title: Denial cache conflates anonymous and renderer identities
findings.description: The key includes `UserUID` but omits `IdentityType`. Both `anonymous:0` and `render:0` are supported subjects. An anonymous denial therefore causes an identical renderer request to be denied for 30 seconds, despite `getRendererPermissions` granting dashboard reads. Include identity type in the key and test both subjects sequentially against one service.

findings.title: Unescaped separators cause denial-key collisions
findings.description: Requests with `(name="a_b", parent="c")` and `(name="a", parent="b_c")` generate identical keys. Their direct and inherited permissions can differ, so denying one incorrectly denies the other. Encode the fields unambiguously and add a collision regression test.

findings.title: Denial-precedence test does not establish an allowing alternative
findings.description: The comment promises an allow entry, but the permission value is `false`. Without the denial-cache shortcut, this request would still be denied, so the test does not prove precedence. Set the permission to `true` and verify the denial entry overrides it.
